verdict.rationale: Paddle is a SaaS billing platform that processes merchant and customer data, so a policy or opt-out on AI-model training is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no AI-training data policy, opt-out control, or training-exclusion commitment. The AI-related items cover the MCP servers, agent skills and the LLM benchmark, which are tools for agents and say nothing about how Paddle uses customer data.
